items.title: Man wanted over alleged attempted murder of 74yo Sydney man
items.description: An arrest warrant has been issued for a 45-year-old man in connection to a violent assault in Western Sydney on Saturday.

items.title: Family pleads for elderly couple's return after leaving care facility
items.description: The couple in their 80s checked themselves out of an aged care facility on Saturday and have not been seen since.

items.title: Family of Perth man raises questions over his Bali death
items.description: The family of Perth man Cameron Hughes, who died in a Bali immigration detention centre, says it has many questions about the circumstances surrounding his death.

items.title: Lindsey Graham, pivotal US Republican senator, dies suddenly at 71
items.description: US senator Lindsey Graham, a key Republican who went from a vocal critic of Donald Trump to one of his most loyal allies, has died at age 71.

items.title: 'Beat the bastard': Arrow vows to help others fight MND
items.description: Former NRL player Jai Arrow says he is determined to raise money and awareness for Motor Neurone Disease until a cure is found.

items.title: Young woman stopped taking the pill because of mental health concerns
items.description: Two young women say taking the pill to manage painful periods had side effects they weren't expecting.

items.title: Live: Intercept try sparks Titans fightback in bid for rare win in Melbourne
items.description: The North Queensland Cowboys will end round 19 inside the NRL top eight, after fullback Scott Drinkwater nailed a drop goal in golden point to defeat the Manly Sea Eagles at Brookvale Oval. Follow live.

items.title: Why Norway feels 'bitter' after contest of controversy against England
items.description: Norway felt England's equaliser shouldn't have stood after the ball appeared to get a deflection off a wire holding up the "spidercam" above the pitch, directly leading to England gaining possession and scoring.

items.title: Third US strike on Iran triggers strait closure, attacks on regional bases
items.description: Iran reportedly responded to Sunday morning's US attacks by closing the Strait of Hormuz and targeting US bases in Qatar, Kuwait and Jordan.

items.title: Body of missing Queensland mum found in bushland
items.description: A 48-year-old man has been charged with murder after the body of missing mother Jana Armstrong was found in bushland late on Saturday.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
